root_cause.text: The `biovec_phys_mergeable` function in the block subsystem fails to validate whether adjacent bio vector segments reside within the same `dev_pagemap` before coalescing them.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states the function "currently has no check for whether the segments belong to different dev_pagemaps," and the patch remedies this by adding `if (!zone_device_pages_have_same_pgmap(vec1->bv_page, vec2->bv_page)) return false;` to prevent merging segments spanning different pgmaps.
